purpose: Replace inference about a failed answer with a complete owner-visible local trace.
records_locally: the exact excerpts selected from connected memory
the evidence passed to the final writer
raw final writer output and the stopping stage
owner_ui: After a memory answer, OPEN TEST LOG opens the private JSON report.
privacy: The report stays on the owner's computer with mode 0600. It contains private memory text and must never be uploaded. No private trace is present in this public record.
release_boundary: This full trace is for owner-only alpha diagnosis and must be removed or reduced to count-only diagnostics before external release.
